target.statement: Final LightGBM model achieves Recall = 1.0 on the test set after Optuna tuning (Fβ optimization with beta=2.7).
target.table_ref: Table 4 (Final Models Results), row LightGBM, column Recall
target.dataset: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic), UCI (569 instances, 30 features)

compute.basis: Dataset is tiny (569x30) and gradient boosting on CPU is fast, but reproducing the exact tuned result requires running Optuna for ~3000 trials per model (LightGBM alone ~3000 trials) plus verifying the repo's split/seed; estimate covers install, data download, and a full Optuna run on 8 CPU cores.

blockers: Exact recall=1.0 depends on the specific 65/35 train-test split and random seed, which may not be fully specified in the paper
Optuna trial counts (thousands) and beta=2.7 are reported but the exact search space and seed are only in the GitHub repo; if repo is incomplete/outdated, exact reproduction is uncertain
Recall=1.0 on a 35% test split (~200 samples) is a small-sample result and may not be stable across seeds
title: Breast Cancer Classification Using Gradient Boosting Algorithms Focusing on Reducing the False Negative and SHAP for Explainability
